en.name: Warrior II
en.subtitle: Strength & stability
steps: Stand with your feet wide and turn one foot outward.
Bend that knee and keep the other leg straight.
Reach both arms out at shoulder height. Face your chest toward the camera.
en.focus: Ground your feet. Reach through your fingertips.

zh-Hant.name: 戰士二式
zh-Hant.subtitle: 可見姿勢檢查
steps: 雙腳分開，將一腳向外轉。
屈曲該側膝蓋，另一腿伸直。
胸口面向鏡頭，雙臂在肩膀高度向兩側伸展。
zh-Hant.focus: 雙腳站穩，向指尖方向延伸。
